method: Actual canonical owner/incoming ranker calls, not two-second samples. Episode stages are unique presence in uninterrupted controlled team possession; direct/set-piece/first-time paths can skip stages. Credible is an unvalidated internal opportunity category, not real-world xG. Support/box/progression candidate counts describe generated alternatives, not an exhaustive oracle of physically available options.
physicalShotLifecycle: Routine accepted shot, preparation eligibility, foot contact and launch are one canonical transaction; no independent asynchronous wind-up state exists. Incoming proposals are revalidated on contact. A missing wind-up counter is not a failed preparation.
